english_version.by: Ministry of Innovation, Science and Technology (an English summary of the policy, mainly of its recommendations chapter)

record.notes: Published in December 2023 by the Ministry of Innovation, Science and Technology, prepared with the Ministry of Justice's Office of Legal Counsel and Legislative Affairs (Economic Law Department) under Government Resolution 212 of 1 August 2021; a White Paper of 17 November 2022 was its first draft and the basis for public consultations. The policy was published in Hebrew; the ministry's English document summarises it, mainly its recommendations chapter. It gives guidelines and instructions to sectoral regulators on AI in the private sector across the AI lifecycle; the government's policy on public-sector AI is developed separately. The policy also anticipates future work on foundation models and frontier AI.

verification.note: Recheck of 18 Oct 2026. gov.il refused every download of the English PDF (the record's official URL) and of the Hebrew policy document (HTTP 403 on 11, 16, 17 and 18 Oct 2026; the browser retry timed out). Stored instead: the OECD.AI policy-initiative entry, added and last updated (25 Dec 2025) by Israel's national contact point, and the 11-page English PDF it links, hosted on api.oecd.ai. That PDF is the ministry's English summary of the policy: it confirms the title, publication in December 2023 by the Ministry of Innovation, Science and Technology with the Ministry of Justice, the seven challenges, the principles and the recommendations, and states that the policy was originally published in Hebrew. The OECD.AI entry confirms the ministries, the Hebrew name, start year 2023, status Active and that the policy is non-binding. Because the Hebrew full text could not be stored, the summary rests on the ministry's English summary and original_title on the OECD.AI entry; whether the OECD-hosted PDF is identical to the gov.il English PDF is not known. Later Israeli initiatives listed on the OECD.AI page (2024-2025) are not part of this policy and are passed on as leads.

judgment.status_reasoning: A non-binding policy published in December 2023; the OECD.AI entry, last updated by Israel's national contact point on 25 Dec 2025, lists it as active and non-binding. Nothing stored shows it withdrawn or replaced. Published (non-binding, current).
judgment.scope_reasoning: Unchanged: a government policy on AI regulation and ethics, in scope with no note.
judgment.date_reasoning: The English summary says the ministry published the policy 'on December 2023' and OECD.AI says 'In December 2023'; no day is given, so date_published stays 2023-12.
judgment.topics_reasoning: The published topics are supported by the English summary: risk-based classification (risk-based approach), human oversight and transparency & labelling (challenges and principles on human oversight, disclosure of AI interactions and explainability), accountability & liability (accountability and legal liability challenge and principle), international cooperation (international interoperability; involvement in international forums). Left unchanged.
judgment.title_reasoning: The English title is the issuing ministry's own English title (page 2 of its English summary), so it stays as the official English title although the official text is Hebrew.

leads: Israel: 'Artificial Intelligence in the Financial Sector – Interim Report of the Inter-Agency Task Force on the Use of Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning in Israel's Financial Sector' (start year 2025), listed as a related initiative on the stored OECD.AI page for IL-01; flexible, sector-specific regulation of AI in finance. Not in the register.
Israel: 'Legal Guide for Designing Regulatory Sandboxes' (start year 2024), written for Israeli regulators, listed on the same OECD.AI page. Not in the register.

Israel: 'National Multi stakeholder consultation forum for AI policy and regulation' (start year 2025), an expert forum to help develop government strategy and policy for the safe use of AI, listed on the same OECD.AI page; may be a mandate of an advisory body. Not in the register.
open_questions: The Hebrew full text of the policy (the official text) is not stored: gov.il refuses the archiver (HTTP 403, browser timeout) for both the Hebrew document and the English summary. The summary rests on the ministry's English summary as hosted by OECD.AI, and original_title on the OECD.AI entry. A person can download https://www.gov.il/BlobFolder/policy/ai_23/he/2023%20Artificial%20Intelligence%20Regulation%20and%20Ethics%20Policy%20Principles%20Document.pdf and https://www.gov.il/BlobFolder/policy/ai_2023/en/Israels%20AI%20Policy%202023.pdf and store them with archive.py --provide, so that the Hebrew title can be quoted verbatim and the record can return to level A.
